summary: Verified the identify screen 404 bug fix. All 4 required frontend scenarios passed. The error state now renders correct copy referencing 'Home → Settings' and '/exec', shows Open Settings + Retry buttons by default, additionally shows 'Use club default' when a stale device override exists, clearing that override on tap works (localStorage keys 'gs.sheetsWebhook' and 'gs.membersWebhook' removed) and the button disappears on re-render, and the success path still shows the search input with no error UI.
critical_code_review_comments: identify.tsx correctly gates the 'Use club default' button on (webhookOverride && defaultWebhook && webhookOverride !== defaultWebhook) — matches spec.
clearWebhookUrl() removes both gs.sheetsWebhook and gs.membersWebhook keys, and load() is re-invoked to fetch again — verified by observing button disappear post-clear.
seed_data_creation: Test 3 seeded stale override URLs into localStorage keys gs.sheetsWebhook and gs.membersWebhook, then cleared them via the app's Use-club-default button.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend Playwright tests used page.route('**script.google.com/**', …) to mock the members webhook (404 for failure paths, 200 with a single member for the success path). AsyncStorage on web maps directly to window.localStorage without a prefix (verified in @react-native-async-storage/async-storage 2.2.0), so seeding keys via window.localStorage.setItem is compatible with the app.
rca_of_issue: Original dead-end: when the device override URL was stale or the shipped default returned 404, the identify screen only showed a Retry button, leaving users no route back to Settings or a way to fall back to the shipped default. Fix in /app/frontend/app/identify.tsx renders three actions in the 404 error state — 'Use club default' (conditional on override != default), 'Open Settings', and 'Retry' — and updates the hint copy to explicitly reference Home → Settings and the /exec URL. Verified via Playwright with mocked webhook responses.

test1_error_copy.notes: Message 'Couldn't load members (HTTP 404)' shown; hint contains Home, Settings and /exec; Open Settings + Retry visible; Use club default NOT rendered when only shipped default is used.

test2_open_settings.notes: Tapping identify-open-settings navigates to /settings and settings-screen testID is present.

test3_stale_override.notes: With gs.sheetsWebhook/gs.membersWebhook seeded to a stale URL, all three buttons visible; hint mentions 'custom Web App URL' and 'Use club default'. After tap, both localStorage keys are removed, screen re-fetches, still 404, but Use-club-default button no longer rendered; Retry remains.

test4_success.notes: With 200 JSON response mocked, loading resolves, search input visible, no Retry or Open Settings buttons in the error card.
